title_zh: 约定提交自行车碰撞的维修凭据

scenario.label_zh: 约定提交自行车碰撞的维修凭据
scenario.goal_zh: 说明快递车辆碰撞后的赔偿诉求，并明确先交维修估价和照片等待审核

context_zh: 虚构服务投诉：一位顾客报告快递车辆碰撞其自行车，公司人员只说明本次处理流程。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: Your driver reported a collision with my parked bicycle yesterday. The front wheel is bent.

sentences.speaker: Agent
sentences.text: I can see the incident report. Are you asking us to compensate you for the repair?

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: Yes. I have a photograph and an estimate from the bicycle shop.

sentences.speaker: Agent
sentences.text: Please send both through this claim form. I can submit them for review, but I cannot confirm compensation or an amount today.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: All right. I'll attach them this afternoon. When should I ask for an update?

sentences.speaker: Agent
sentences.text: If you haven't heard from the claims team by Friday, reply to the confirmation email with your reference number.
